entries.name: team-list
entries.purpose: Full team list — source for admin team search, cached 24h (§43).

entries.name: rankings
entries.purpose: Rankings feed. Confirms poll names and whether CFP is published (§7).

entries.name: scoreboard-20260917
entries.purpose: One day's slate. Source of live/final/odd-status game ids (§11, §18).

entries.name: calendar
entries.purpose: Bare scoreboard — carries the season/week calendar used by §21.

entries.name: team-ranked
entries.purpose: A ranked team: rank + record field paths (§7, §8).

entries.name: schedule-ranked
entries.purpose: Full-season schedule for a ranked team (§17).

entries.name: team-unranked
entries.purpose: An unranked team — must normalize to `unranked`, not `unavailable` (§7).

entries.name: schedule-unranked
entries.purpose: Schedule with gaps in the week sequence — the bye-week source (§10, §22).

entries.name: game-final
entries.purpose: Completed game: result and final score (§9).

entries.name: conferences-index
entries.purpose: FBS conference group ids ($ref list). Hop 1 of conference-name resolution.

entries.name: conference-single
entries.purpose: One resolved conference (name, shortName, logo). Hop 2.

entries.name: prediction-present
entries.purpose: Matchup predictor when ESPN publishes one (§12).

entries.name: prediction-absent
entries.purpose: The 404 body for a game with no predictor — must normalize to `null`, never 0% (§12, §46).

entries.name: game-upcoming
entries.purpose: Scheduled game: kickoff, broadcast, null scores (§10).

entries.name: game-postponed
entries.purpose: A genuinely postponed game. Note state="post" with completed=false (§18).

entries.name: game-live
entries.purpose: Live game: period, clock, no winner (§11). SYNTHETIC.
